Branches gather and share meals with the families who need them most.

Local gatherings that bring a neighbourhood together around a shared cause.

privacy.metaDescription: What Hamqadam Volunteers collects when you apply to volunteer or send a message, who can see it, and how to ask us to delete it. No national ID number is collected.
privacy.title: Privacy
body: We collect only what we need to process volunteer applications and contact messages: your name, email address, phone number, preferred branch, availability, skills and the reasons you give.
We never ask for a national identity card (CNIC) number or other identity documents.
Applications are visible only to our HR team and system administrators. Accepted volunteers become members of a branch; their contact details are visible to that branch's lead.
We do not sell or share your details. We keep them while you volunteer with us, and you can ask us to delete them by writing through the contact page.
The site stores no tracking cookies. Staff sign-in uses one essential session cookie.

terms.metaDescription: Terms of use of the Hamqadam Volunteers website: send only accurate details, volunteering is unpaid, event details can change, and no payments are taken online.
terms.title: Terms of use
body: This website gives information about our volunteer branches, programs and events, and lets you apply to volunteer or contact us.
Information you send must be accurate and your own. Do not send other people's details without their permission.
Volunteering is unpaid. Submitting an application does not guarantee a place.
We may update program and event information at any time. Event dates and places can change; check this site before you travel.
The site does not take payments or donations online.
